source.title: An electrophysiological dissociation between orbitofrontal reality filtering and context source monitoring

confidence_rationale: Directly relevant and cuts both ways. Within one continuous-recognition task, reality filtering produced a frontal positivity with posterior medial orbitofrontal activity at 200-300 ms, while context source monitoring had NO electrophysiological expression in that early window and instead produced a prolonged frontal positivity from 400 ms, slower and less accurate. This SUPPORTS MECH-037's architectural boundary -- the paper's own framing is that the gate amplifies or suppresses candidates without being the slower, deliberate source-attribution process, which is exactly REE's 'the loop does not mint authority writes and does not bypass E3/verifier commit checks'. It WEAKENS the claim's content model: MECH-037 has the gate reading provenance (where/when the content came from), and provenance read-out here is demonstrably the slow post-gate process, not the gate. Confidence 0.70 -- strong design and direct relevance, but healthy participants only, N not stated in the abstract, single lab, and the authors themselves flag that the behavioural correlate of deficient source monitoring remains unverified.
failure_signatures: Context source monitoring has no electrophysiological expression at 200-300 ms, the window in which the reality-filtering gate operates -- so a gate implemented as a source/provenance look-up cannot run at gate latency.
Source monitoring is slower and less accurate than reality filtering on the same stimuli in the same subjects, indicating two mechanisms rather than one graded one.

Deficient orbitofrontal reality filtering has an established behavioural correlate (reality confusion in thinking); deficient source monitoring does not yet have a verified one, so the two failures are not interchangeable evidence for one gate.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Context source monitoring (remembering the precise past context in which a piece of information was acquired) and orbitofrontal reality filtering (sensing whether an upcoming thought refers to present reality and may be acted upon) were juxtaposed within a single continuous recognition task while high-resolution evoked potentials were recorded in healthy participants. They dissociated both behaviourally and electrophysiologically: reality filtering induced a frontal positivity and posterior medial orbitofrontal activity at 200-300 ms, while source monitoring had no electrophysiological expression in that early period, was slower and less accurate, and induced a prolonged frontal positivity starting at 400 ms.
mapping.ree_translation: Two things for REE, pointing opposite ways. The supportive one is structural and worth keeping: there really is a fast gate that runs BEFORE the deliberate source-attribution machinery, and it is dissociable from it. That is the shape MECH-037 asserts when it says the loop 'can amplify or suppress candidate trajectories' but 'does not mint authority writes and does not bypass E3/verifier commit checks' -- a fast pre-commitment bias, not a second verifier. The weakening one is about content: MECH-037 has the gate reading provenance, and in humans provenance read-out is the 400 ms process, not the 200-300 ms one. Combined with Liverani et al. 2015 in this same directory, the pattern is consistent -- everything REE nominates as the gate's INPUT (temporal order, source context) turns out to be a slow process downstream of the gate.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Healthy participants only; the abstract does not state N. ERP source localisation is coarse, so 'posterior medial orbitofrontal activity' is an inference, not a measurement. The dissociation is established within one task, and the authors explicitly note that the behavioural correlate of deficient source monitoring still needs controlled exploration -- so the asymmetry in clinical consequence is an open question, not a settled finding. Mapping REE's E1/E3 commitment architecture onto a continuous-recognition ERP paradigm is a substantial abstraction in both directions.
mapping.source_context: Human high-resolution evoked potentials in healthy participants; single continuous recognition task combining source-monitoring and reality-filtering demands.

confidence_components.notes: Good peer-reviewed within-task dissociation with direct bearing on both halves of MECH-037 (the architectural boundary it supports, the content model it weakens). Docked for unstated N, single lab, healthy-only sample, and coarse source localisation.
